title: Reasoning Judgment Interface Composition
scope: runtime adapter/composition/boundary and AST ADT aliases

results.name: generic semantic reasoning owns the reusable judgment operation
results.detail: The judge operation is a shared reasoning contract rather than duplicated by each domain contract.

results.name: dataflow authority composes the generic judgment contract
results.detail: The semantic-dataflow contract specializes the existing reasoning judgment interface for canonical input and judgment ADTs.

results.name: dataflow authority contract retains upstream ownership marker
results.detail: The shared judge shape does not weaken the semantic ownership boundary.

results.name: dataflow authority contract retains a domain-specific discriminant
results.detail: Runtime composition can identify the concrete authority contract without exposing its solver.

results.name: canonical authority remains the only binding to the concrete solver
results.detail: The implementation constructor is bound once behind the upstream authority object.

results.name: runtime adapter depends on the authority interface
results.detail: The runtime adapter invokes the contract rather than importing the concrete solver.

results.name: runtime adapter exposes the closed consumer authority, not fake execution methods
results.detail: The runtime consumer surface exposes closed state/query/closure and does not imitate producer execution.

results.name: runtime adapter does not import the concrete solver
results.detail: The wiring adapter cannot bypass the upstream authority contract.

results.name: composition root binds the canonical authority
results.detail: Concrete implementation selection remains in the explicit composition root.

results.name: runtime boundary expresses upstream-to-runtime wiring
results.detail: The contract direction remains upstream evidence to downstream read-only authority projection.

results.name: analysis pipeline consumes the injected runtime boundary
results.detail: Analysis orchestration does not choose a solver or construct a second judgment.

results.name: AST dataflow input and judgment remain canonical aliases
results.detail: AST-facing dataflow does not introduce a parallel input or judgment representation.

results.name: operation identity has a domain-specific runtime algebra contract
results.detail: Operation identity construction is typed separately from the closed result ADT.

results.name: operation identity authority delegates to its algebra
results.detail: The authority does not reconstruct identity capability fields.

results.name: operation identity algebra preserves semantic proof
results.detail: Capability construction retains the original proof, derivation, and provenance.

results.name: operation identity projection consumes the closed capability
results.detail: The downstream projection serializes identity without reclassification.

results.name: manifest projection forwards canonical inputs
results.detail: Manifest wiring transports semantic evidence but does not solve it.

results.name: IR projects closed closure and canonical identity
results.detail: IR consumes the canonical closed state instead of creating a parallel solver.

results.name: structural graph has a distinct relation-to-edge projection
results.detail: Structural graph reasoning remains distinct from runtime value dataflow.

results.name: React and SDK remain consumers of endpoint capability
results.detail: React and SDK do not infer endpoint identity from raw method/path data.

results.name: CLI consumes the upstream operation identity reference
results.detail: The emitter projects a closed capability instead of recreating identity.

results.name: semantic ownership and prior audit chain remain available
results.detail: The focused contract audit supplements rather than replaces broad ownership and phase audits.

results.name: Laravel example and frontend targets remain present
results.detail: The source-to-target example remains available for cross-layer trace.

results.name: package script is registered without changing release/build contract
results.detail: Audit is reproducible and the package version/build command remain unchanged.

decisions.decision: Compose the domain authority interface from the shared SemanticReasoningJudgmentInterface.
decisions.reason: The domain contract should specialize the existing reasoning operation rather than redeclare the same judge signature.

decisions.decision: Keep the concrete solver binding in semanticDataflowRuntimeComposition and make adapters depend on the contract.
decisions.reason: Runtime wiring selects the implementation; adapters execute the upstream contract without owning closure.

decisions.decision: Preserve canonical SemanticDataflowInput/Judgment aliases and existing consumer projections.
decisions.reason: AST syntax, semantic dataflow, structural graph, and IR are related but not interchangeable models.
